conceptual_change: Test whether an unusually negative 20-bar z-score of BTCUSDT 1H close-to-VWAP distance identifies a VWAP/volume-profile dislocation.
rationale: The selected BTC-compatible discovery survivor explicitly describes VWAP/volume-profile proxies. The evaluator defines vwap_distance as the relative close-to-VWAP deviation; a 20-bar z-score is a dimensionless test of an unusually negative deviation. This is a pre-OOS test hypothesis only; it makes no performance or efficacy claim.
